name: Monash Undergraduate Accommodation Scholarship
summary: A $2,587 accommodation scholarship for Monash undergraduates in financial hardship who will live in Monash University Accommodation.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder.
Enrolled or intending to enrol in an undergraduate degree at a Monash campus in Australia.
Experiencing financial hardship and intending to live in Monash University Accommodation.
how: Apply to Monash University Accommodation for a room, and apply through VTAC SEAS or directly to Monash.
catches: Can't be held with any other accommodation scholarship.
